## Plan Review PR

**Use this template when:** a specification project is proposing the plan for a new release (Plan Review).

**Specification project:** <!-- add link here -->

### Include the following in the PR

- [ ] A directory in the form `wombat/x.y`, where `x.y` is the release major.minor version
- [ ] An index page `wombat/x.y/_index.md` following the [specification page template](https://github.com/jakartaee/specification-committee/blob/master/spec_page_template.md)
- [ ] A title in the form "Jakarta Wombat X.Y (under development)"
- [ ] A plan for the release. A couple of statements is usually enough; otherwise, link to a document describing the release.
- [ ] A detailed description of any backward incompatibility (check and mark **N/A** if none)
- [ ] The optional features declared, if there are any (check and mark **N/A** if none)
- [ ] The minimum Java SE version
- [ ] A description of any updates or required changes, including splitting out the TCK (check and mark **N/A** if not planned)
- [ ] A link to the updated release record

> Replace `wombat` with your specification's short name. If an item does not apply, check it and mark it **N/A** below it.
